input: heights is a rectangular R by C array of positive safe integers; repeated heights are allowed. Empty outer and zero-width arrays are accepted. All collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse arrays or accessor-backed collections. Node fields, where present, are ordinary data fields. Every individual collection length and computed allocation dimension/count fits [0,4294967295]; explicitly stated padded sizes and heap child-index arithmetic must also fit the declared exact numeric domain. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is permitted. Preconditions are not runtime-checked; allocation/resource capacity and actual completion still require qualification. JavaScript integer inputs are primitive safe-integer Number, excluding negative zero, NaN, infinities, fractions and BigInt; separately declared probabilities are finite primitive Number.
return: Fresh R by C matrix counting people visible strictly rightward in the same row or strictly downward in the same column. Two people see one another exactly when every intervening height is strictly smaller than the minimum endpoint height. Diagonal people are excluded.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and row identities remain unchanged, including read-only aliased rows. Every output row is fresh and independent; copied column vectors, helper results and stacks are private. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Heights are only compared. Per-cell counts are at most R+C-2, with R+C within the safe integer range. The nearest equal-height blocker is counted but replaces a farther equal stack entry, so equal heights cannot be counted through one another. All integer inputs and integer intermediates (apart from opaque Python identity keys) remain in [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(R*C + R + C + 1) time and O(R*C + R + C + 1) auxiliary/output space. Each row/column height is pushed and popped at most once per helper call; column copies and helper output arrays are included, not hidden. Bounds count ordinary built-in allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop, and stated hash/sort guarantees where relevant.

helpers.name: visibleAhead
helpers.contract: Returns visibility counts to the right in one height sequence. Scanning right-to-left maintains a strictly decreasing stack from bottom to top; shorter blockers are popped/countable, then at most one taller/equal blocker is counted. An equal blocker is replaced by the nearer equal height.
helpers.cost: O(L+1) time and O(L+1) auxiliary/output space for sequence length L. Full helper is charged once in the standalone source and invoked on every row and copied column. The complete definition is 503 UTF-8 bytes; separator newlines are included in total source bytes.

source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 1019 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper definition, Solution wrapper, signatures, loops, built-in calls, comments/annotations, whitespace and terminal newline. Shared helper spelling is fully charged in each candidate, not a free library. No imports, runtime-generated implementation, external helper or hidden expansion is used. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source; interface/effect parity remains unqualified.
